rooms.name: Eastbound Landing Concourse
rooms.description: A rain-slick concourse opens into Brightash beneath flickering arrival holograms.
rooms.verbose_description:
You step out under a low canopy of animated holo-ads that stutter in the mist, their colors bleeding across puddles like spilled neon.
A row of battered intake vents exhales warm, recycled air that smells of ozone and street food.
Beyond the security stanchions, Brightash stretches away—narrow avenues, towering facades, and the steady hiss of runoff.

A sign over the exit pulses: "WELCOME TO BRIGHTASH // KEEP MOVING."

rooms.name: Crossway Vendor Arcade
rooms.description: Crowded stalls glow under hanging signs as vendors hawk parts and meals.
rooms.verbose_description:
A tight arcade of pop-up kiosks crowds the walkway, each one lit by a different palette of cheap LEDs and dancing holograms.
Service drones buzz low, dodging shoulders and umbrellas, while the floor reflects every color like a mirror.
You catch snippets of bargaining, the clink of credits, and the tinny beat of street music leaking from a nearby door.

Most people keep one eye on the wares and one eye on the cameras.

rooms.name: Boulevard Mirror Pavers
rooms.description: The boulevard’s wet stone tiles reflect towering ads and passing silhouettes.
rooms.verbose_description:
Rainwater pools between pavers and turns the boulevard into a long, shimmering strip of light.
Above, building faces rise like cliffs—holo-billboards looping glossy promises while their signal glitches at the edges.
A transit rail hums somewhere overhead, and the air vibrates with distant engines and crowd noise.

Every few seconds, a security drone’s spotlight sweeps the street and moves on.

rooms.name: Neon Service Cutthrough
rooms.description: A narrow cutthrough funnels you past humming conduit banks and steaming grates.
rooms.verbose_description:
This passage squeezes between two buildings so close you could touch both walls at once.
Conduits run exposed along the brickwork, their insulation patched and repatched, humming with steady power.
Steam vents hiss from a grate underfoot, briefly fogging the air before the rain pulls it down again.

A faded arrow points toward the crossway—half peeled, still confident.

rooms.name: Highrise Lobby Threshold
rooms.description: A guarded lobby mouth yawns open beneath locked elevators and cold marble.
rooms.verbose_description:
A recessed lobby offers a momentary shelter from the rain, though the air feels no warmer.
Polished stone tries to look expensive, but the corners are scuffed and the lighting flickers out of sync.
Two elevator doors sit sealed behind clearance panels, their indicator lights pulsing a steady, denying red.

A camera tracks you smoothly, and you can feel the building deciding you don’t belong upstairs.

rooms.name: North Avenue Dripline
rooms.description: A long avenue runs north under endless runoff and pulsing signage.
rooms.verbose_description:
Runoff spills in steady curtains from condensation vents high above, creating a constant, soft roar.
Umbrellas, coats, and plastic hoods blur into a moving river of people who know how to keep pace.
The neon here leans colder—industrial blues and stark whites—like the city is already changing as you head north.

Somewhere beneath the street, machinery thrums like a sleeping beast.

rooms.name: Industrial Glow Corridor
rooms.description: The avenue tightens into cleaner steel-lined walls and cautious lighting.
rooms.verbose_description:
Street façades give way to metal cladding and utility hatches, each one labeled with worn hazard glyphs.
The rain still falls, but the drainage works better here, channeling water in neat streams that vanish into grates.
You hear the sharper sounds of work—tools, compressors, the clack of maintenance panels being sealed.

A posted notice warns: "FILTRATION ACCESS // AUTHORIZED PERSONNEL ONLY."

rooms.name: Skybridge Access Stairs
rooms.description: Stairs and a catwalk junction rise between towers, slick with rain and light.
rooms.verbose_description:
A set of narrow stairs climbs to a catwalk that threads between buildings like a steel vein.
Below, the street churns with noise; up here, you get the sharper hiss of wind and the electric buzz of holo-ads.
A maintenance panel hangs open, its guts exposed—wires tied off with quick, ugly knots.

From this junction, Brightash feels layered: street-level chaos below, guarded heights above.

rooms.name: Northwalk Billboard Overlook
rooms.description: A catwalk overlook frames the city in neon reflections and drifting mist.
rooms.verbose_description:
The catwalk widens into a small overlook with a waist-high rail and a view down the avenue.
A massive billboard hovers nearby, its hologram drifting a few inches out of alignment, giving everything a ghosted double-image.
The wind carries the smell of wet circuitry and hot exhaust, and the rain needles in sideways.

For a moment, you can watch Brightash instead of being swallowed by it.

rooms.name: Commerce Spire Forecourt
rooms.description: A forecourt beneath tower fronts blazes with ads and guarded doors.
rooms.verbose_description:
Tower lobbies loom on either side, their doors flanked by scanners and quiet, watchful drones.
Holographic advertisements drift through the rain, occasionally glitching into jagged pixel storms before stabilizing.
The ground is a mosaic of puddles and projected signage, turning every footstep into a ripple of light.

A stairwell and a lift access point hint at levels above—and trouble below.

rooms.name: Night Clinic Intake
rooms.description: A sterile intake door glows in the rain, promising fast treatment and faster billing.
rooms.verbose_description:
A bright panel reads NIGHT CLINIC in calm letters that don’t match the street outside.
Inside the threshold, the air turns antiseptic, and the hum of filtration nearly drowns the city’s roar.
A queue line is painted on the floor, though it’s mostly ignored by people with fresh bandages and older worries.

A kiosk chirps softly: "STATE SYMPTOMS. CONFIRM PAYMENT. BREATHE."

rooms.name: Brightash Security Checkpoint
rooms.description: A checkpoint corridor narrows under scanners and watchful lights.
rooms.verbose_description:
The passage funnels into a controlled choke point where overhead scanners sweep in slow arcs.
A metal gate stands open, but its hinges look ready to slam shut at a moment’s notice.
Muted warning tones pulse from recessed speakers, more psychological than functional.

Even the rain seems to fall more quietly here, as if it respects the cameras.

rooms.name: Corporate Lobby Doors
rooms.description: Locked corporate doors gleam behind spotless glass and red clearance lights.
rooms.verbose_description:
A broad set of glass doors reflects you back with painful clarity.
Inside, you can see immaculate tile, silent furniture, and a reception desk that looks more like a barrier than a welcome.
The access panel flashes "CLEARANCE REQUIRED" with the cheerful certainty of a system that never negotiates.

A drone idles near the ceiling, its lens fixed on you like a polite threat.

rooms.name: Central Crossway Kiosk
rooms.description: The city’s main crossway churns with traffic around a glowing mission kiosk.
rooms.verbose_description:
Here, the north–south avenue collides with the east–west boulevard in a bright, noisy knot.
A tall kiosk stands at the center, wrapped in scrolling postings, bounties, and contract offers that refresh every few seconds.
People flow around it in practiced arcs—messengers, workers, tourists, and the ones who watch too closely.

Overhead, a skyrail rumbles past, and the crossway shivers with its passing.

rooms.name: Overwalk Support Pier
rooms.description: A raised pier supports the overwalk above, webbed with pipes and dripping cables.
rooms.verbose_description:
The street angles under a raised overwalk, its underside crowded with pipes, cable bundles, and maintenance ladders.
Water drips from every seam, tapping out uneven rhythms on the metal plates below.
A faint bassline leaks from somewhere nearby, mixing with the constant generator hum.

Graffiti tags mark the safer routes—some honest, some traps.

rooms.name: Locked Elevator Alcove
rooms.description: An alcove holds a sealed elevator with a dead call button and fresh scratch marks.
rooms.verbose_description:
A recessed elevator alcove offers shelter but no access.
The call button is dark, and the clearance reader is clean enough to imply someone cares.
Scratch marks gouge the surrounding metal where someone tried to pry the doors open—recent, angry, and futile.

The city keeps its heights guarded, and it makes that point often.

rooms.name: Service Alley Wetwall
rooms.description: A grim service alley runs between wet walls and buzzing utility boxes.
rooms.verbose_description:
The alley narrows into a channel where rainwater cascades down stained concrete.
Utility boxes line the wall, each one humming with uncertain power, their covers secured with mismatched bolts.
Somewhere deeper, a small drone whirs as it scrapes grime off a sensor lens.

The neon here is dimmer, but the shadows feel more awake.

rooms.name: Sump Gate Junction
rooms.description: A junction of drains and maintenance access opens over a deep city sump.
rooms.verbose_description:
A heavy grate splits the ground, and you can hear water rushing beneath it.
Two maintenance corridors peel off from the junction, each marked with stenciled numbers and faded hazard stripes.
A warm updraft carries the smell of hot metal and old runoff, turning the rain into a thin fog at ankle height.

This is where Brightash hides its mess—down below, out of sight.

rooms.name: Advertisement Drift Plaza
rooms.description: A small plaza hosts floating ads that jitter and dance in the rain.
rooms.verbose_description:
The space opens just enough for a cluster of holo-ads to occupy the air like playful ghosts.
They drift, rotate, and occasionally glitch into fractured shapes before smoothing back into polished mascots and slogans.
Puddles catch every projection, doubling the spectacle on the ground.

A few people linger here, not shopping—just staring, letting the colors wash over them.

rooms.name: Training Loft Catwalks
rooms.description: Elevated catwalks circle a training loft lit by steady white worklights.
rooms.verbose_description:
Up here, the neon gives way to honest lighting and the sharp smell of disinfectant.
A ring of catwalks overlooks an open training floor marked with scuffed lines and impact dents.
A battered instructor console hums at the edge, and you can hear the thud of practice strikes echoing through the metal.

Beyond the rail, Brightash sprawls below—beautiful and indifferent.

rooms.name: Westbound Narrowway
rooms.description: The boulevard pinches into a westward narrowway of dripping signs and shadow.
rooms.verbose_description:
The street constricts as buildings lean closer, their lower levels packed with bolted shutters and suspicious doorways.
Neon signs hang low enough to brush tall heads, their tubes sputtering in the rain.
A faint chemical tang rises from a side drain, mixing with smoke from street grills.

Footsteps echo here longer than they should, like the walls are listening.

rooms.name: Ashlight Alley Mouth
rooms.description: An alley mouth opens west, marked by ash-gray brick and flickering arrows.
rooms.verbose_description:
A cluster of directional arrows has been projected onto the wall—some official, some not.
The bricks are stained a permanent gray, as if the city’s soot has soaked in deeper than cleaning can reach.
Rainwater threads down the mortar lines and pools around scattered shell casings and bottle glass.

Whatever lies west feels older, seedier, and more patient.

rooms.name: Skyrail Underpass
rooms.description: A loud underpass shakes with the overhead skyrail and dripping rivulets.
rooms.verbose_description:
The skyrail runs directly overhead, and every passing car sends a tremor through the steel ribs of the underpass.
Water drips from rivets in steady beats, splashing into dark puddles that smell faintly metallic.
A few maintenance ladders climb into shadowed access ports, each one padlocked.

The noise makes it hard to hear anyone approaching—which is the point.

rooms.name: Seamline Service Door
rooms.description: A heavy service door sits in a seam of concrete, tagged and half-welded.
rooms.verbose_description:
A thick metal service door rests flush with the wall, its hinges reinforced and its seams scarred by old repairs.
Warning labels have been scratched away, replaced by layered graffiti and crude symbols.
The air here is warmer, as if something behind the door is working hard to stay alive.

A tiny red LED blinks above the latch—steady, stubborn, and unreadable.

rooms.name: Crossway Flooded Median
rooms.description: A flooded median links back toward the crossway through shimmering reflections.
rooms.verbose_description:
The median is little more than a raised strip of stone, but it’s flooded anyway—rain doesn’t respect design.
Reflections stack here: signs above, faces below, the city doubled into something almost too bright to look at.
You can hear the crossway’s pulse from nearby—traffic, music, and the ever-present generator hum.

A faint breeze carries fresh mist from the north, cold and clean compared to the west.

rooms.name: Maintenance Latchway
rooms.description: A latchway drops south into service routes marked by hazard stripes and grime.
rooms.verbose_description:
Hazard stripes paint the edges of a narrow access route where the city’s public face gives up.
The lights shift to utilitarian amber, and the walls are scuffed by carts, boots, and hurried repairs.
A maintenance sign lists routing codes that mean nothing to civilians.

The air down here tastes like hot dust and wet metal.

rooms.name: Utility Crawl Passage
rooms.description: A low utility passage runs west, crowded with pipes and vibrating panels.
rooms.verbose_description:
The ceiling dips low, forcing you to hunch beneath fat coolant lines that tremble with flow.
Panels along the wall rattle softly, a constant reminder that Brightash is powered by aging systems.
A few emergency glow-strips flicker, painting the corridor in tired green light.

It feels like walking through the city’s bloodstream.

rooms.name: East Boulevard Runoff
rooms.description: An eastward stretch of boulevard shines with runoff and commerce lights.
rooms.verbose_description:
The boulevard broadens slightly, allowing carts and foot traffic to weave around each other without stopping.
Rainwater streams along a shallow channel cut into the street, reflecting a ribbon of neon that never breaks.
Delivery drones skim low, their rotors throwing mist into tiny whirlwinds.

Farther east, the glow shifts toward logistics—less luxury, more movement.

rooms.name: Logistics Sign Canyon
rooms.description: Tall signs form a canyon as logistics routes peel toward elevated walkways.
rooms.verbose_description:
Vertical signage stacks up the building faces like a canyon of light—shipping codes, depot arrows, and shifting timetables.
The rain here is broken by overhangs, dripping in slow curtains instead of sheets.
A stairwell and a ramp hint at routes that climb toward the city’s mid-level arteries.

You can feel the tug of traffic patterns—where the city wants you to go.

rooms.name: Lower Yards Approach
rooms.description: The air turns heavier as the boulevard approaches the Lower Yards’ logistics sprawl.
rooms.verbose_description:
The street lights shift from playful neon to harsh, practical beams.
Metal barricades line the edges, and the pavement is scarred with tire marks and dragging tracks.
You hear forklifts, warning beeps, and distant engines idling like impatient animals.

A painted symbol on the ground reads: YARDS ACCESS // KEEP CLEAR.

rooms.name: Sublevel Drain Gallery
rooms.description: A sublevel gallery opens under the streets with dripping arches and echoing water.
rooms.verbose_description:
You drop below street level into a space carved by maintenance necessity and decades of patchwork.
Arched supports hold the city’s weight overhead while water runs in channels along the floor.
The sound is all echoes—drips, distant footsteps, and the low groan of pumps working overtime.

Down here, the neon is a memory—only thin light leaks through grates like wounded stars.

rooms.name: Pump Room Corridor
rooms.description: A corridor beside the pumpworks vibrates with pressure lines and deep mechanical thrum.
rooms.verbose_description:
Pressure lines run along the walls, painted with faded color codes and reinforced with fresh clamps.
The pumpworks throb behind a grated partition, and warm air pulses out in timed breaths.
Condensation beads on every surface and slides down in tiny rivers.

This is the kind of place where the city’s failures collect—and get pushed elsewhere.

rooms.name: Ash Pits Transit Gate
rooms.description: A reinforced transit gate hums beside a sealed corridor leading west into the Ash Pits.
rooms.verbose_description:
A heavy frame of reinforced alloy surrounds a gated passage, its field projectors emitting a low, steady hum.
Warning lights blink in patient rhythm, and a simple placard labels the route: ASH PITS ACCESS.
The air here is warmer, tinged with soot, as if the zone beyond breathes into this threshold.

A control pedestal waits for authorization—or a stubborn enough traveler to try anyway.

rooms.name: Back Alley Cantina
rooms.description: A hidden cantina glows behind a half-shuttered door, spilling music into the rain.
rooms.verbose_description:
A battered door hangs under a sign that flickers between two names, neither fully readable.
Warm light spills out, amber and soft, cutting through the wet darkness like a promise.
Inside, the air is thick with spice, recycled heat, and cheap synth liquor, and the bassline makes your ribs hum.

The crowd here keeps their backs to the wall and their eyes on the exits... just in case.
